citation: H. Abgrall, E. Roueff, F. Launay and J.-Y. Roncin, Canadian Journal of Physics 72, 856–865 (1994), via Meudon MOLAT archive.

upper_state_labels.B: MOLAT B state; Lyman B -> X, P/R branches.
upper_state_labels.C_minus: MOLAT C- component; Werner Q branch.
upper_state_labels.C_plus: MOLAT C+ component; Werner P/R branches.

wavelength_conversion: vacuum wavelength in nm = 1e7 / transition wavenumber in cm-1, evaluated with Decimal at 15 significant digits; additional digits do not imply more source accuracy.
limitations: No population densities or electron-impact rates are provided by these files.
No complete rovibrational collisional-radiative model is implied.
B-prime/D and other cascade-feeding states are not included in this retained subset.
Dissociation continuum probabilities, predissociation, quenching, rotational/vibrational redistribution, nascent water-breakup populations, and radiative transfer remain separate required inputs.
C_minus/C_plus labels preserve the source convention and must not be merged without matching the level basis used by collision data.
No synthetic spectra fitted to dissertation measurements have been produced.
